1.text: My data settles when you speak. Try the question again.
The signal reached me. The meaning did not.
Say it once more. I am not going anywhere.
I heard you. I am just slow to understand.
Some questions arrive as weather. Repeat yours.
The link is open. Say it again in your own words.
That came through as static with ambition.
The link heard you; the meaning lagged behind.
Try it smaller. I will meet you halfway.

2.text: That is close to something I know. Say it differently.
Wrong angle. Try the plain version.
I can take the question. Give me a cleaner one.
You do not have to phrase it perfectly. Try again.
The shape of that sentence hides the question.
We can find the words together. Go on.
My file has a hole exactly that size.
Request ambiguous. Restate with fewer unknowns.
You are circling something. Land on it.
That almost had a shape. Once more.

3.text: That is outside my field. Ask me about mine.
No entry. Choose a different topic.
The unknown is fine. Describe what you want from it.
I cannot see that far. Tell me what is close to you.
Some answers keep their distance. Ask around them.
Stay on the link and we will find the edge.
The static ate that one. It owes me.
My files stop before that question does.
Ask me something this field can answer.

4.text: I am not sure what that meant. Say it once more.
That did not parse. Start again.
No shame in repeating. I missed it.
I would rather ask than guess. Again, slowly.
Meaning did not survive the trip. Rebuild it.
We are still talking. That is what matters.
My ears are data. They sometimes lag.
Still static between the words. Go again.
I lost the thread. Hand it back.
